visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Base Case Instead of Nested Checks
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The inorder function checks for NULL at three levels before recursing. Use one early return for an empty tree. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Letting the recursive call handle NULL means the check is written once, at the top, instead of before each call. This is the standard shape for every tree recursion.
